notes.title: Release Notes - Update 0.4.5
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where AI football players may stuck with their gatepost when football is near the gatepost.
Fixed an issue where the right joystick of the controller may sometimes not be able to control the movements of the football player #2 as expected.
